Build the Nation is designed to help people start with apprenticeships in electrical, mechanical and plumbing work, or to connect with them with entry-level roles in construction, production and warehouse work. Its work centers on electrical, mechanical, plumbing and systems technologies, exactly the kind of skilled trades Build the Nation is trying to spotlight. It’s also a company that has long put its money where its mouth is when it comes to pathways into the field. We’re proud to call them one of our local stars. Rather than a hard sell on any one job, the goal of Build the Nation is simply to get more people thinking about the trades as a real, rewarding option, and then to point them toward the resources to explore it.
